knownDeltas: Export pixels are engine-native Skia output over the published style: there is no Esri reference render to diff against, so the gate is structural (PNG signature, IHDR dimensions, raster headers, non-trivial body), never byte equality and never a perceptual hash against a foreign image.
esriResponse pins the media contract (PNG at the requested size), not sample pixels.
name: mapserver-export-image
notes: Export image (MapServer/export?f=image): the doc-pattern bbox/size/format over the published map; the replay gates the PNG structurally because renderers are never byte-equal across engines.
source: Esri REST docs: Export Map (https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/services-reference/enterprise/export-map.htm); f=image pattern
